title: Free energy landscape of Dense Associative Memory
abstract: arXiv:2607.19195v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Using large deviations theory, we solve and obtain a general expression for the free energy functional for a broad class of associative memories, including dense associative memories. We illustrate the method by reproducing classical results for the Hopfield model. For a finite number of patterns, we derive the temperature-dependent free energy functional for dense associative memories featuring polynomial interactions and Log-Sum-Exponential (LSE) activation. We also obtain the disorder-averaged ground-state energy landscape of these systems in the extensive limit. Our analytical framework reveals how memory retrieval depends on the initial state in higher-order dense networks, and gives the exact error-free threshold for the LSE model. This method provides a systematic procedure for analyzing diverse, complex architectures in associative memory.

translated_title: 稠密联想记忆的自由能景观
translated_abstract: 利用大偏差理论，我们求解并得到了包括稠密联想记忆在内的一类广泛联想记忆模型的自由能泛函的一般表达式。我们通过重现Hopfield模型的经典结果来说明该方法。对于有限数量的模式，我们推导了具有多项式交互和Log-Sum-Exponential（LSE）激活函数的稠密联想记忆的温度相关自由能泛函。我们还获得了这些系统在广延极限下的无序平均基态能量景观。我们的分析框架揭示了高阶稠密网络中记忆检索如何依赖于初始状态，并给出了LSE模型的精确无误阈值。该方法为分析联想记忆中多样、复杂的架构提供了系统化的流程。
tldr: 本文利用大偏差理论推导出包含稠密联想记忆在内的广泛联想记忆模型的自由能泛函通用表达式，揭示了高阶稠密网络中记忆检索对初始状态的依赖性，并给出了LSE模型的精确无误检索阈值。
en_tdlr: Using large deviations theory, this paper derives a general expression for the free energy functional of a broad class of associative memories including dense associative memories, reveals how memory retrieval depends on initial states in higher-order dense networks, and provides the exact error-free threshold for the LSE model.
